desc:
🎿 Welcome to Ski For Eggs! 🥚

📖 How to Play:
🥚 Ski down the mountain to find and collect eggs
🏃 Train on the treadmill to increase your speed
⚡ Get faster so you can reach eggs before everyone else
🎿 Steal eggs and ski them all the way back to your base
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⬆️ Upgrade your base and become even faster
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Play on Mobile, Console, Desktop, and Tablet!
🥽 VR support soon!
